Counting the almonds in the photo gives about 18. A typical almond weighs about 1.2 g, so the total is roughly 22 g. At about 7 kcal per gram for almonds, that comes to around 150 kcal.

The plate looks like a side plate of about 20-22 cm, and the almonds are about 2.5 cm long, which fits a normal almond size. I used 1.2 g per almond, which is on the high side of the usual range, so the total could be slightly lower. A small reddish smear and a bit of carrot-colored debris are on the plate, but they add almost no food energy.
